question: How many cumulative confirmed measles cases will Mexico's daily measles bulletin report on November 26, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Bulletin total jumped from 20,552 (Nov 11) to 20,701 (Nov 12/13) via final-classification batches (Nov 10: +115 backdated; Jalisco +142 on Nov 12). New transmission is minimal (6 active cases). 10 weekday editions remain to Nov 26. Late-Oct pace was ~3-10/day; post-PAHO-visit pace ~40-60/day. Backlog of ~900 under study caps the upside. Median ~+190 over 20,701. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi none).

calls.reasoning: The latest bulletin (12 Nov) shows 20,701. Growth is now driven by batch final-classification of the backlog, not new transmission (only 6 active cases). From 5 to 12 Nov batches added ~290 over 5 bulletins. Before that, growth was 2-10/day. PAHO's review ended 13 Nov, so the clean-up may either slow or finish. The under-study pool of ~750-850 with a ~44% confirmation rate caps plausible additions at a few hundred. My median is about +150, with a right skew.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the factual base: 20,701 in the 12 Nov bulletin, about 10 bulletins left, a pool of ~700-900 under study, and 6 active cases. Whether a 13 Nov bulletin exists can't be settled from the dossiers. That has little effect, because press reports give 20,701 'hasta 13 nov'. The disagreement is only a judgment call about the pace of backlog adjudication after PAHO's 10-13 Nov review. I expect batches to continue at a slower pace than 5-12 Nov, giving a median of ~+150. Run 1's 90th percentile tail is limited by the size of the under-study pool. I keep a 4% chance above 21,350 for a single large batch. I see no mechanism for a downward revision.
